description: Saintes Grandes Rives, l'Agglo: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Saintes Grandes Rives, l'Agglo. Coverage: Saintes Grandes Rives, l'Agglo. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Nombre de places de stationnement vélo; Horaires théoriques du réseau BUSS - Saintes (GTFS); Horaires temps-réel du réseau BUSS - Saintes (GTFS-RT); Dates de fermeture du réseau cuivre en Charente-Maritime. Formats seen: URL, CSV, PAGE WEB, GTFS-RT, GZ. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf), as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
